blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The United Church of Christ in the Philippines (UCCP) on Tuesday called for the release of Rev. Edwin Egar, who was earlier arrested in connection with a terrorism financing case. “Nanawagan tayo sa agarang pagpapalaya kay Rev. Edwin Egar!” the UCCP said in a statement. (We call for the immediate release of Rev. Edwin Egar!) The UCCP said Egar had just arrived at Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3 when personnel of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) arrested him pursuant to an arrest warrant issued by the Batangas Regional Trial Court Branch.
